bca_jr_select_category_other_unselected = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_other } } }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_all
                set_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_other
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_energy
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_minerals
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_food
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_alloys
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_consumer_goods
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_trade
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_unity
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_physics_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_society_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_engineering_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_rare_crystals
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_volatile_motes
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_exotic_gases
                country_event = { id = colony_automation_event.2001 }
            }

bca_gui_select_tab_economy_selected = {
    potential = {
        exists = from
        from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 } }
    }
    allow = { always = yes }
}


bca_gui_select_tab_economy_unselected = {
    potential = {
        exists = from
        from = { NOR = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 } } }
    }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                set_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 0 }
                bca_jr_clear_slot_mapping = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

        exists = from
        from = { NOR = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 } } }
    }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                set_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 }
                country_event = { id = colony_automation_event.2001 }
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_global_off_selected = {
    potential = { exists = from from = { check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 } NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_enabled } } }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_enabled
            }
        }
    }
}
